businesses.business: nutritional supplements and skin care sold through direct selling

offering_description.value: Designs and sells nutritional supplements and skin care products to consumers through a network of independent distributors. Products are made by contract manufacturers and sold mainly through distributor-led sales and monthly auto-ship orders.

primary_products.value: dietary supplements; skin care products; weight management products; energy drink mixes

customer_segment.value: B2C: Individual consumers buying wellness products through independent distributors or online

end_markets.value: health and wellness; nutritional supplements; personal care

revenue_model.value: product sales: Supplements and skin care products sold to distributors and consumers; subscription: Monthly auto-ship orders of supplements and skin care products

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Designs and markets products made by contract manufacturers, sold to consumers via distributors; other: Runs a direct selling network that recruits and compensates independent distributors

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Mexico, Japan, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: Nutritional supplements and skin care products sold through one direct selling model

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Independent distributors who sell and recruit other distributors; online: Company website and online ordering for products and distributor enrollment

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Dietary supplement and product claim rules from FDA and FTC, plus direct selling regulations in each market

notes: Product lineup and market list may have changed; details are based on my general knowledge of the company.
